name: STIHL MS 311 / MS 391
blurb: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on 3/8″ chain, .050″ gauge, 60–72 drive links, per STIHL's chain-selection chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 311 and MS 391 appear in STIHL's saw-chain selection chart with identical rows, so this one page covers both. Both list 16″, 18″ and 20″ guide bars: standard 3/8″ pitch at .050″ gauge, in 60, 66 and 72 links. Note that this is not the same chain as the 3/8″ low-profile “Picco” loops on STIHL’s small saws. File size is where STIHL and Oregon disagree: STIHL’s 2025 catalog file table lists a 13/64″ (5.2 mm) round file for 3/8″ chain, while Oregon’s filing chart gives 7/32″ (5.5 mm) for its standard 3/8″ chain (72, 73, 75), so the table shows both.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 60 with recommended bar 3003 008 8913.
STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 66 with recommended bar 3003 008 8917.
STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 72 with recommended bar 3003 008 8921.

sources.title: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (STIHL USA catalog page 173; specifications as of 1 October 2017): recommended chain loop and guide bar per saw model
STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: Saw Chain Selection and Identification chart (catalog pages 166–167), chainsaw spec tables, saw chain and file pages
Saw Chain Filing Angles / Grinding Angles chart (2020): 7/32″ round file for standard 3/8″ chain (types 72, 73, 75)

sources_note: STIHL USA “Saw Chain Selection and Identification” chart (catalog page 173, specifications as of 1 October 2017), read on 24 Oct 2026.
